description: CG13494 architecture: AlphaFold pLDDT, hydropathy profile, and compositional segments
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
A="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8MZA7-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text
pl=[float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"]
pl=np.array(pl); assert len(pl)==120
kd={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=19; h=np.array([kd[c] for c in A])
hyd=np.array([h[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1].mean() for i in range(120)])
x=np.arange(1,121)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(11,7),sharex=True,
                      gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.3,1.3,0.9]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(x,pl,color="#2c3e50",lw=1.6)
ax.fill_between(x,0,pl,where=pl>=70,color="#2980b9",alpha=.35)
for y,lab,col in [(90,"very high","#888"),(70,"confident","#888"),(50,"low","#888")]:
    ax.axhline(y,ls=":",lw=.8,color=col); ax.text(121,y,lab,fontsize=7,va="center")
ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(20,100)
ax.set_title("CG13494 (Q8MZA7, 120 aa): one confident transmembrane helix, everything else low confidence",fontsize=11)
ax=axes[1]
ax.plot(x,hyd,color="#c0392b",lw=1.6); ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",lw=.9,color="#555")
ax.text(2,1.75,"Kyte-Doolittle 1.6 membrane threshold",fontsize=7,color="#555")
ax.axhline(0,lw=.6,color="#999"); ax.set_ylabel("hydropathy (window 19)")
ax=axes[2]
for i,c in enumerate(A,1):
    col={"C":"#e67e22","G":"#27ae60","D":"#2980b9","E":"#2980b9","T":"#8e44ad","S":"#8e44ad"}.get(c,"#bdc3c7")
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((i-.5,0),1,1,color=col))
ax.set_xlim(0.5,120.5); ax.set_ylim(0,1); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue")
ax.text(17,1.25,"Thr/Ser-rich (T = 32% of 1-34)",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.text(48,1.25,"TM helix 37-61 (Phobius)",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.text(96,1.25,"Cys/Gly/Asp low complexity (C 26%, G 38%, D 20%)",ha="center",fontsize=8)
for a in axes[:2]:
    a.axvspan(37,61,color="#2980b9",alpha=.12)
    a.axvspan(1,34,color="#8e44ad",alpha=.07)
    a.axvspan(71,120,color="#e67e22",alpha=.08)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("pLDDT means: 1-34 %.1f | 37-61 %.1f | 71-120 %.1f"%(pl[:34].mean(),pl[36:61].mean(),pl[70:].mean()))
print("max hydropathy window:", round(hyd.max(),2), "at residue", int(np.argmax(hyd))+1)
print("residues with window hydropathy > 1.6:", int((hyd>1.6).sum()), "span", int(x[hyd>1.6].min()), "-", int(x[hyd>1.6].max()))
